note: Implementation/evidence mapping, not tracker progress. Existing means a baseline wrapper, not a claim that all original contracts were correct. Seven separately approved Elixir SDK-parity additions have no original campaign finding or issue IDs.

result_contract.applies_to: All supported HTTP operations and their convenience, scoped, and explicit-account interfaces, including baseline operations with no proposed_interfaces. This breaking result contract supersedes historical success-shape compatibility requirements without changing endpoint counts, request behavior, or provenance.
result_contract.bang_error: Raises the structured ReqDnsimple.Error, retaining reason and metadata.
result_contract.response_module: ReqDnsimple.Response formats results and defines the public result type; it is not a returned struct.

metadata_fields.status: HTTP status for one response; nil on an aggregate.
metadata_fields.pagination: Optional nested string-keyed pagination map; nil on an aggregate.
metadata_fields.rate_limit_remaining: Optional non-negative integer remaining budget; zero is meaningful.
metadata_fields.rate_limit_reset: Optional non-negative integer Unix seconds, not milliseconds or a duration.
metadata_fields.request_id: Optional opaque request ID string; nil on an aggregate.
metadata_fields.etag: Optional opaque string, preserving quotes and weak prefixes; nil on an aggregate.
metadata_fields.retry_after: Optional opaque delay or HTTP-date string; retained in metadata, not reason.retry_after.
metadata_fields.pages: Defaults to []; aggregate page metadata is preserved in request order, including empty and single-page collections.
metadata_fields.parse_errors: Defaults to {}; malformed headers and body pagination are explicitly recorded without turning valid resource data into a failed result.

result_contract.missing_metadata: Missing optional fields are nil. Local validation and transport failures have metadata: nil unless prior enumeration responses must be retained.

aggregate_metadata.page_order: Request order, including empty and single-page responses; no fabricated collection-wide ETag.
aggregate_metadata.http_failure: Error.metadata retains the failing response fields and pages includes completed plus failed page metadata.
aggregate_metadata.transport_failure: Error.metadata retains prior page metadata without fabricating a failed HTTP response.
aggregate_metadata.partial_results: An incomplete traversal never returns a success-shaped partial collection.

success_flags.pagination_in_metadata: Whether pagination belongs to the top-level response Metadata.pagination; false for aggregate metadata.
success_flags.pagination_in_metadata_pages: True for complete enumeration, whose individual pagination maps live in Metadata.pages.
success_flags.metadata_scope: response for one HTTP response; aggregate for complete enumeration.

result_contract.identity: whoami data retains {:user, user}, {:account, account}, or {:unknown_token, body} inside the uniform success tuple.
result_contract.non_paginated_collections: Account.list and other non-paginated collections return data and response Metadata in the same ok tuple.
result_contract.error_reason: Retains the original reason, including status and response body for generic HTTP failures; available response fields are retained in metadata.
result_contract.pure_helpers: OAuth.authorize_url/2,3 remains {:ok, url} or {:error, %NimbleOptions.ValidationError{}} without HTTP metadata. Constructors and for_account return Req.Request and still raise ArgumentError on invalid configuration.
result_contract.non_goals: No automatic rate limiting, retries, or caching are added. Raw response bodies and headers are not retained wholesale in Metadata.
